name: Hero — Mesh + Floating Cards
description: Fintech/SaaS hero: drifting mesh gradient, blur-in headline and CTAs, and floating product cards bobbing at different rhythms.
a11y: Real h1 and links; decorative cards aria-hidden; bobbing and mesh stop under reduced motion.
perf: @property mesh in CSS; three small looping transforms.
prompt: Build a SaaS hero: background = three radial gradients (violet, cyan, pink) whose anchor % animate via @property; left column: announcement pill, H1, subtitle and two CTAs entering with y 20 + blur 6 → 0 staggered 100ms (expo-out); right column: three product cards (volume chart, payment succeeded, conversion) that bob y [0,−10,0] on 5–7s loops.

name: Hero — Video Dialog
description: Product thumbnail with a pulsing play button that expands (shared layout) into a full-screen video dialog.
a11y: Play is a labelled button; dialog is aria-modal, Esc/backdrop/close button dismiss, focus moves to Close.
prompt: Create a hero with a video thumbnail button (pulsing ping ring + white play disc) sharing a layoutId with a centered dialog that holds the video, so clicking morphs the thumbnail into the player; blurred backdrop; Esc closes.

name: Hero — Floating Gallery
description: Headline surrounded by photos floating at different depths that parallax against the pointer.
a11y: Images decorative (aria-hidden); text centered and legible; parallax off on touch/reduced motion.
perf: Two springs shared by all images; transforms only.
prompt: Build a floating-gallery hero: six rotated photos absolutely placed around a centered headline, each translated by the springed pointer offset × −60px × its depth factor (0.6–2.2) for multi-layer parallax; pop in with stagger.

name: Hero — Scroll Tilt Screenshot
description: Product screenshot starts tilted back in 3D under the headline and rotates flat while scaling up as you scroll.
a11y: Content order unchanged; reduced motion shows it flat.
prompt: Create a scroll-tilt hero: a 180vh section with a sticky 100vh stage (perspective 1000px); map scroll progress 0→.6 to rotateX 24°→0°, scale .9→1 on a bezel-framed screenshot (origin top) and to headline y 0→−80px.

name: Hero — Editorial Studio
description: Agency portfolio opener: an oversized name rising letter by letter, a clip-path image reveal and a slow marquee of disciplines.
a11y: h1 keeps an aria-label of the full name; reduced motion renders the final layout.
prompt: Build an editorial hero on an off-white paper background: tiny top meta row, a giant (15vw) black name whose letters rise from y 110% staggered 50ms, an image revealed by clip-path inset(100%→0) while scaling 1.4→1, the name blending over it with mix-blend difference, and a bottom marquee of disciplines.

name: Hero — Dev Tool Terminal
description: Developer-tool hero: headline, a copyable install command, and a terminal that types the session and its output.
a11y: Copy button labelled with the command; terminal is decorative (aria-hidden) duplicate of info.
prompt: Create a dev-tool hero: left — version link, H1, subtitle, a mono command chip that copies to clipboard and flips its icon to a check; right — a terminal window typing the command at 45ms/char then printing ✔ lines every 380ms.

name: Hero — Dotted Globe
description: Canvas dotted globe (orthographic projection, no WebGL) that rotates, tilts toward the pointer and draws travelling arcs between cities.
a11y: Canvas has role=img and a description; static frame under reduced motion.
perf: ~800 dots + arcs on a 2D canvas; pauses off-screen.
prompt: Draw a dotted globe on canvas: Fibonacci-sphere points filtered by a pseudo-land mask; orthographic projection with rotation = t·.25 and a pointer-driven tilt; draw only front-facing dots with depth-based alpha; arcs interpolate lat/lon, lift outward by sin(πf)·.18 and sweep along with a 40% trailing window.

name: Hero — Spotlight Grid
description: Grid-lined hero lit by a cursor spotlight, with avatar social proof, a gradient headline and dual CTAs.
a11y: Spotlight is decorative; content is semantic; spotlight hidden under reduced motion.
perf: CSS vars set on pointermove; no re-renders.
prompt: Build a spotlight grid hero: 56px line grid masked with a radial fade, a 500px brand-colored radial spotlight positioned by --x/--y CSS vars from pointermove, avatar stack + '12,000+' proof, gradient-clipped H1 and two CTAs that enter with staggered y.
